name: Spelling and grammar
description: Checks spelling and grammar in notes without a network: Harper for English, Hunspell dictionaries for other languages, a personal dictionary, and `writer check` for agents.

memory.note: Harper's English dictionary and rules load on the first check of an English note (tens of MB) and a Hunspell dictionary loads when a note in that language is first checked; the language detector loads when a long paragraph is first checked. Nothing runs until a note is open. The Rust part needs a restart to start or stop.
